ai.safetyBased: Partly - concerns unresolved, then applicant withdrew
ai.reasonDetail: Applied for in 2021 as a mammal repellent. EFSA's August 2025 technical report found the composition and maximum capsaicinoid content unspecified, capsaicinoids genotoxic in vitro and in vivo with a genotoxicity data gap and no toxicological reference values, so neither the consumer nor the non-dietary risk assessment could be finalised, plus wide ecotox data gaps. Concerns could not be eliminated and the applicant withdrew on 30/04/2026.
